mensagens.content: Document the CPU instructions before decomposition. Answer ONLY JSON: {"instructions": [{"mnemonic", "description"}]}. Give one concise implementation-oriented description for every mnemonic, with no extras. Document these mnemonics: lui, auipc, jal, jalr, beq, bne, blt, bge, bltu, bgeu, lb, lh, lw, lbu, lhu, sb, sh, sw, addi, slti, sltiu, xori, ori, andi, slli, srli, srai, add, sub, sll, slt, sltu, xor, srl, sra, or, and.

Instruction inventory (must be covered by the blocks): [{"mnemonic": "lui", "description": "U-type: rd = instr[31:12] << 12."}, {"mnemonic": "auipc", "description": "U-type: rd = pc + (instr[31:12] << 12)."}, {"mnemonic": "jal", "description": "J-type: rd = pc + 4; pc = pc + sign-extended J immediate."}, {"mnemonic": "jalr", "description": "I-type: rd = pc + 4; pc = (rs1 + sign-extended I immediate) & 0xFFFFFFFE."}, {"mnemonic": "beq", "description": "B-type: if rs1 == rs2 then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4."}, {"mnemonic": "bne", "description": "B-type: if rs1 != rs2 then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4."}, {"mnemonic": "blt", "description": "B-type: if signed(rs1) < signed(rs2) then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4."}, {"mnemonic": "bge", "description": "B-type: if signed(rs1) >= signed(rs2) then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4."}, {"mnemonic": "bltu", "description": "B-type: if unsigned(rs1) < unsigned(rs2) then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4."}, {"mnemonic": "bgeu", "description": "B-type: if unsigned(rs1) >= unsigned(rs2) then pc = pc + sign-extended B immediate else pc = pc + 4."}, {"mnemonic": "lb", "description": "Load byte: read 8 bits at rs1 + sign-extended I immediate and sign-extend to 32 bits into rd."}, {"mnemonic": "lh", "description": "Load halfword: read 16 bits at rs1 + sign-extended I immediate and sign-extend to 32 bits into rd."}, {"mnemonic": "lw", "description": "Load word: read 32 bits at rs1 + sign-extended I immediate into rd."}, {"mnemonic": "lbu", "description": "Load byte unsigned: read 8 bits at rs1 + sign-extended I immediate and zero-extend to 32 bits into rd."}, {"mnemonic": "lhu", "description": "Load halfword unsigned: read 16 bits at rs1 + sign-extended I immediate and zero-extend to 32 bits into rd."}, {"mnemonic": "sb", "description": "Store byte: write rs2[7:0] to rs1 + sign-extended S immediate."}, {"mnemonic": "sh", "description": "Store halfword: write rs2[15:0] to rs1 + sign-extended S immediate."}, {"mnemonic": "sw", "description": "Store word: write rs2[31:0] to rs1 + sign-extended S immediate."}, {"mnemonic": "addi", "description": "OP-IMM: rd = rs1 + sign-extended I immediate."}, {"mnemonic": "slti", "description": "OP-IMM: rd = 1 if signed(rs1) < signed(I immediate) else 0."}, {"mnemonic": "sltiu", "description": "OP-IMM: rd = 1 if unsigned(rs1) < unsigned(I immediate) else 0."}, {"mnemonic": "xori", "description": "OP-IMM: rd = rs1 XOR sign-extended I immediate."}, {"mnemonic": "ori", "description": "OP-IMM: rd = rs1 OR sign-extended I immediate."}, {"mnemonic": "andi", "description": "OP-IMM: rd = rs1 AND sign-extended I immediate."}, {"mnemonic": "slli", "description": "OP-IMM: rd = rs1 logical left shift by instr[24:20]."}, {"mnemonic": "srli", "description": "OP-IMM: rd = rs1 logical right shift by instr[24:20]."}, {"mnemonic": "srai", "description": "OP-IMM: rd = rs1 arithmetic right shift by instr[24:20]."}, {"mnemonic": "add", "description": "OP: rd = rs1 + rs2."}, {"mnemonic": "sub", "description": "OP: rd = rs1 - rs2."}, {"mnemonic": "sll", "description": "OP: rd = rs1 logical left shift by rs2[4:0]."}, {"mnemonic": "slt", "description": "OP: rd = 1 if signed(rs1) < signed(rs2) else 0."}, {"mnemonic": "sltu", "description": "OP: rd = 1 if unsigned(rs1) < unsigned(rs2) else 0."}, {"mnemonic": "xor", "description": "OP: rd = rs1 XOR rs2."}, {"mnemonic": "srl", "description": "OP: rd = rs1 logical right shift by rs2[4:0]."}, {"mnemonic": "sra", "description": "OP: rd = rs1 arithmetic right shift by rs2[4:0]."}, {"mnemonic": "or", "description": "OP: rd = rs1 OR rs2."}, {"mnemonic": "and", "description": "OP: rd = rs1 AND rs2."}]

Decompose this monociclo RV32I CPU into hardware blocks. Answer ONLY with JSON: {"blocks": [{"name", "responsibility", "ports", "depends_on", "design_rationale"}], "notes"}.
Rules: 2 to 8 blocks; each block becomes src/<name>.vhd with `entity <name>`; lowercase names; never reuse a provided entity (cpu_package, data_memory, data_ram, data_rom, instruction_memory, memory_package); the LAST block is `cpu`, the top level that instantiates the other generated blocks and exposes the contract bus ports; `ports` are VHDL port declarations such as "clk : in std_logic"; do NOT emit a `satisfies` field or enumerate FR-RV IDs; `design_rationale` justifies the block by area, speed or verifiability; `depends_on` lists only generated block names required before this block (use [] for leaves).

resposta:
{
  "blocks": [
    {
      "name": "register_file",
      "responsibility": "32x32 register file with asynchronous reset, x0 hardwired to zero, asynchronous reads, and synchronous write on rising clock when write_en is asserted.",
      "ports": [
        "clk : in std_logic",
        "rst : in std_logic",
        "write_en : in std_logic",
        "rs1_addr : in std_logic_vector(4 downto 0)",
        "rs2_addr : in std_logic_vector(4 downto 0)",
        "rd_addr : in std_logic_vector(4 downto 0)",
        "rd_data : in std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "rs1_data : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "rs2_data : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)"
      ],
      "depends_on": [],
      "design_rationale": "Isolates the only architectural register state, simplifies x0 and reset handling, and makes register write behavior independently verifiable."
    },
    {
      "name": "immediate_gen",
      "responsibility": "Generate sign-extended I, S, B, U, and J immediates from the 32-bit instruction word according to the RV32I field mapping.",
      "ports": [
        "instr : in std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "imm_i : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "imm_s : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "imm_b : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "imm_u : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "imm_j : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)"
      ],
      "depends_on": [],
      "design_rationale": "A dedicated combinational immediate generator avoids duplicated bit manipulations, reduces top-level wiring, and makes ISA immediate mapping directly auditable."
    },
    {
      "name": "control_decoder",
      "responsibility": "Decode RV32I opcode, funct3, and funct7 into control signals for ALU operation, immediate selection, register write, memory access, branch evaluation, and jump handling.",
      "ports": [
        "instr : in std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "alu_a_src : out std_logic",
        "alu_src : out std_logic",
        "alu_op : out std_logic_vector(3 downto 0)",
        "imm_sel : out std_logic_vector(2 downto 0)",
        "reg_write : out std_logic",
        "mem_read : out std_logic",
        "mem_write : out std_logic",
        "mem_width : out std_logic_vector(1 downto 0)",
        "branch : out std_logic",
        "branch_type : out std_logic_vector(2 downto 0)",
        "jump : out std_logic",
        "jalr : out std_logic"
      ],
      "depends_on": [],
      "design_rationale": "Centralizes ISA semantics in one small combinational block, reducing top-level complexity and improving verifiability of instruction behavior."
    },
    {
      "name": "alu",
      "responsibility": "Compute 32-bit arithmetic, logical, shift, comparison, and pass-through results used by ALU instructions, address generation, target generation, and LUI.",
      "ports": [
        "a : in std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "b : in std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "alu_op : in std_logic_vector(3 downto 0)",
        "result : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)"
      ],
      "depends_on": [],
      "design_rationale": "A single shared datapath minimizes area and keeps the critical path short; a fixed operation encoding simplifies verification."
    },
    {
      "name": "branch_unit",
      "responsibility": "Evaluate branch conditions for BEQ, BNE, BLT, BGE, BLTU, and BGEU using rs1, rs2, branch_type, and branch_en.",
      "ports": [
        "rs1_data : in std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "rs2_data : in std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "branch_type : in std_logic_vector(2 downto 0)",
        "branch_en : in std_logic",
        "branch_taken : out std_logic"
      ],
      "depends_on": [],
      "design_rationale": "Isolates signed and unsigned branch comparisons from the ALU, avoids unnecessary ALU side effects, and makes branch semantics easy to test."
    },
    {
      "name": "load_extend",
      "responsibility": "Select byte, halfword, or word data from the asynchronous 32-bit memory read word and apply sign or zero extension according to funct3 and address low bits.",
      "ports": [
        "data_read_data : in std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "addr_low : in std_logic_vector(1 downto 0)",
        "funct3 : in std_logic_vector(2 downto 0)",
        "load_data : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)"
      ],
      "depends_on": [],
      "design_rationale": "Separates little-endian byte/half selection and load extension rules into a small combinational block, improving clarity and verification of load instructions."
    },
    {
      "name": "cpu",
      "responsibility": "Top-level single-cycle RV32I CPU: owns the PC register, instantiates the generated blocks, muxes operands and writeback data, computes next PC priority, and drives the required external bus contract.",
      "ports": [
        "clk : in std_logic",
        "rst : in std_logic",
        "instr_addr : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "instr_data : in std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "data_addr : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "data_write : out std_logic",
        "data_width : out std_logic_vector(1 downto 0)",
        "data_write_data : out std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)",
        "data_read_data : in std_logic_vector(31 downto 0)"
      ],
      "depends_on": [
        "register_file",
        "immediate_gen",
        "control_decoder",
        "alu",
        "branch_unit",
        "load_extend"
      ],
      "design_rationale": "Keeps the externally visible entity stable and minimal while delegating ISA-specific logic to independently testable blocks, reducing top-level area and verification risk."
    }
  ],
  "notes": "All generated blocks except register_file and cpu are purely combinational. The cpu block owns the PC register and implements next-PC priority: JAL/JALR, taken branch, pc+4. During asynchronous reset, cpu forces PC and memory-write outputs to safe values. Suggested encodings: imm_sel 000=I, 001=S, 010=B, 011=U, 100=J; alu_op 0000=ADD, 0001=SUB, 0010=SLL, 0011=SLT, 0100=SLTU, 0101=XOR, 0110=SRL, 0111=SRA, 1000=OR, 1001=AND, 1010=PASS_B; branch_type 000=BEQ, 001=BNE, 010=BLT, 011=BGE, 100=BLTU, 101=BGEU."
}
